relationships.subject: TNF-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: pro-inflammatory cytokines such as interleukin-1 beta (IL-1β) and tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-α) impair glutamatergic and GABAergic signaling, disrupt long-term potentiation (LTP), and inhibit neurogenesis

relationships.subject: BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: dysregulation of brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) signaling exacerbates synaptic vulnerability, contributing to cognitive decline

key_findings: Chronic pain causes cognitive dysfunction via neuroinflammation, neurotransmitter dysregulation and impaired synaptic plasticity in hippocampus and mPFC.
Pro-inflammatory cytokines and BDNF dysregulation are key molecular contributors.
